get.summary: Get how many albums use each field
get.description: Every field of the account, with the albums applying it, active and in Trash, even empty. Settings shows it, and a used field's type can't change (FR-03.12, DS-60).

get.summary: Get what deleting a field affects
get.description: The field with its options, the albums applying it, active and in Trash, and the scope hash that confirms deleting exactly that. `field.delete` always needs that hash, and refuses it if the field or the albums applying it changed meanwhile (FR-03.18, TS-14).

200.description: What deleting a field affects (FR-03.18, TS-14).

inTrash.description: Albums in Trash applying the field.

scopeHash.description: Confirms exactly this scope: pass it to `field.delete`. The deletion is refused if the field or the albums applying it changed meanwhile.

get.summary: Get what removing an option affects
get.description: The albums choosing the option, active and in Trash, and the scope hash that confirms removing it from exactly them. `field.removeOption` needs that hash when any album chooses the option, and refuses it if the albums changed meanwhile (FR-03.17, TS-14).

schema.description: A mutation envelope (TS-20).

result.description: What the mutation reports. `membership.add` gives `{alreadyInList: boolean}`, true when the album was already in the list (FR-01.7); `album.capture` gives a `CaptureResult`; the others give null.

type.description: `about:blank`: the status and `code` carry the meaning.

base.description: The value the change assumed; absent when it created the record.

dependsOn.description: The `mutationId` of the first prerequisite not confirmed.

schema.description: A mutation's outcome (TS-27).

post.description: Runs up to 200 `BatchItem`s in order, each on its own, so a success stays whatever happens to later items (TS-25). An item runs only once every item it `dependsOn` is confirmed; otherwise it is `skipped`. Each item is validated and made idempotent by its `mutationId` as a single mutation is, so sending the batch again applies nothing twice. An `album.capture` item still running in another request answers the batch `409 in_progress`: the items before it stay saved, and sending the batch again replays them.

batchId.description: Made by the client; the answer carries it.

items.description: A `BatchItem` (`#/components/schemas/BatchItem`). Each item is validated on its own: one that isn't a valid `BatchItem` gets a `failed` outcome, and the others still run.
